summary: Plan HR initiatives with charters, schedules, RACI and risk logs. Explore the five-day foundation course and strengthen project delivery.
lede: HR project management applies planning and control methods to workforce initiatives, from process changes to HRIS improvements. For HR coordinators, operations managers and business partners, this course supports defining deliverables and keeping work visible alongside ongoing employee services. Learners build skills in chartering and breaking down work, mapping schedules and responsibilities, managing risks and dependencies, and tracking requirements, readiness and intended benefits.
audienceIntro: This foundation course is designed for people who coordinate HR initiatives alongside ongoing employee services and need a repeatable way to define work, control delivery and report progress.
prerequisites: Prior project-management experience is not required. Familiarity with HR processes or participation in an HR initiative will help you connect the exercises to your work. No coding or programming is required.
